CheckTitle: Ensure IAM password policy requires minimum length of 14 or greater
CheckType: Software and Configuration Checks/Industry and Regulatory Standards/CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark
Software and Configuration Checks/AWS Security Best Practices/Identity and Access Management
Description: Checks that the account password policy requires passwords of at least 14 characters.
Risk: Short passwords are vulnerable to brute-force and credential-stuffing attacks.

Recommendation.Text: Set the account password policy minimum length to 14 or more characters.
